whatTheChangeActuallyDoes: New migration 20261020_0018 (AFC-539, parent AFC-510): full-table REVOKE UPDATE ON welfare_case_events FROM directus_app -- a strict tightening over the 0009 grant of UPDATE (detail, body), so no column-level UPDATE survives; SELECT + INSERT untouched. Bootstrap-role DO block (fail closed, ADR-0002); conditional to_regclass guard with loud NOTICE for Directus-first installs where 0009 never ran (0002 section 10 / 0005 / 0017 pattern); rerunnable. No trigger/function/rule/FK/role statements -- only the REVOKE, so the privilege gate and the rollback-control gate have nothing to reconcile. Down script restores exactly GRANT UPDATE (detail, body), same conditional-guard style, IF-free GRANT inside the guarded DO block; no drops of any kind. Suite 77 section 77.6 gains two pins (app UPDATE on detail must 42501; app UPDATE on body must 42501; WHERE-false probes, no rows mutated) and the header comment now states append-only since AFC-510. No GRANT added anywhere to make tests pass.
deviationsStated: One, declared. The down script uses GRANT inside a DO block rather than a top-level GRANT so the absent-table case stays a NOTICE-loud no-op; the granted privilege is byte-identical to 0009 section 4.
